introduction:
In Delhi, the Caste Certificate for SC, ST, and OBC is issued by the Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM) office under the Revenue Department, Government of NCT of Delhi. It is mandatory for availing reservations in government admissions, jobs, and Central Government welfare schemes.

Applications can be filed online through the Delhi e-District Portal or offline at the nearest SDM / Tehsil office. OBC certificates in Delhi are particularly governed by the Central OBC list (not Delhi state list).
quickFacts:
Important to Know
  • Service Name: Issuance of Caste Certificate (OBC/SC/ST)
  • State/UT: Delhi
  • Official Portal: edistrict.delhigovt.nic.in
  • Issuing Authority: Executive Magistrate / Tehsildar
  • Prescribed Timeline: 14 Days
documentsRequired:
Documents Required

Note: All uploaded documents must be in PDF or JPG format and strictly under 200 KB in size.
Mandatory Proofs
  • Identity Proof: Aadhaar Card, Driving License, Passport, PAN Card, etc.
  • Permanent Address Proof: Electricity Bill, Bank Passbook with photograph, Ration Card, etc.
  • Present Residence Proof: Ration Card, Electricity Bill, Gas Bill, Voter ID, etc.
  • Self-Declaration Form: A specific form that must be downloaded, printed, filled, signed by the applicant (or parent if a minor), and then scanned and uploaded.
Historical Residence Proof
  • Residence Proof in Delhi before 1993: Any official document proving your family resided in Delhi prior to 1993 (e.g., Old Electricity/Water Bill, Old Driving License, Old Passport, Rent Agreement, Voter ID issued before 1993).
  • Note: This is mandatory if you do not have a paternal blood relative who already possesses an OBC certificate.
onlineApplication:
Method 1: Apply Online via Delhi e-District Portal

Step-by-Step Process:
  1. Step 1: Registration/Login: Visit the e-District Delhi portal. If you are a new user, click "Register," select a document type (Aadhaar or Voter ID), enter details, and complete the registration form with your present and permanent address. You will receive a User ID and password via SMS. If already registered, simply click "Login."
  2. Step 2: Access Services: Once logged in, click on the menu icon, navigate to Apply Online, and select Apply for Services.
  3. Step 3: Select Caste Certificate: Scroll down to the Department of Revenue section and click on "Apply" next to "Issuance of Caste (OBC) Certificate" (or SC/ST as applicable).
  4. Step 4: Fill the Application Form:
    • Select the State (Delhi).
    • Choose whether you are applying for the Central or State list.
    • Select your specific Caste from the dropdown menu.
    • Answer questions regarding your family's residence in Delhi before 1993.
    • Crucial Step: You will be asked if any paternal blood relative possesses an OBC certificate. If "Yes", provide their details (Name, Relationship, Issuing State, Certificate Number, Issue Date, etc.). If "No", you must have the 1993 residence proof.
    • Creamy Layer Criteria: Answer a series of questions to determine if you fall under the "Creamy Layer" (e.g., if parents hold constitutional posts, Class I/II officer ranks, specific agricultural land limits, or have a gross annual income over 8 lakhs). For standard applicants seeking the certificate, most of these answers will be "No".
    • Click "Continue to Next".
  5. Step 5: Upload Documents: Upload the mandatory documents (Identity Proof, Permanent Address Proof, Residence Proof, and 1993 Proof/Relative's Certificate).
  6. Step 6: Self-Declaration:
    • To get this form, search Google for "delhi caste certificate self declaration", click on the link to dccentral.delhi.gov.in, download the application form PDF, and print only the "Self-Declaration" page (usually the last page).
    • Fill in your name, father's name, age, address, date, place, and sign it.
    • Scan and upload this document in the "Self Declaration" section.
  7. Step 7: Submit: After uploading all documents, click "Submit". An application slip will be generated containing a 14-digit Application Number. Save this number for future tracking.
offlineApplication:
Method 2: Apply Offline

Step-by-Step Process:
  1. Step 1: Visit the Office: Visit the office of the Sub-Divisional Magistrate (SDM) or Tehsildar in your respective jurisdiction/district.
  2. Step 2: Collect Form: Request the application form for the issuance of a Caste Certificate.
  3. Step 3: Fill Form: Fill out the application form meticulously with accurate personal, address, and caste details.
  4. Step 4: Attach Documents: Attach self-attested photocopies of all required documents (Identity Proof, Address Proof, Proof of residence before 1993 OR paternal relative's caste certificate, and passport-size photographs).
  5. Step 5: Affidavit/Self-Declaration: You will also need to submit a sworn affidavit or a signed self-declaration form as prescribed by the office.
  6. Step 6: Submit: Submit the completed application form along with the documents at the designated counter and collect your acknowledgement receipt.
afterApplying:
After Applying — Next Steps

Track Status

You can track the status of your application on the e-District portal by logging in or entering your 14-digit application number in the tracking section.

Download Certificate

Once your application is approved by the Executive Magistrate/Tehsildar, log in to your e-District account. Navigate to Menu -> Print -> Print Certificate and enter your 14-digit application number to download your digitally signed certificate.
